verdict.rationale: The pack documents a full API, an MCP server, fhcli, and Runbooks that automate steps for each incident. None of it describes a bulk operation that acts on many items at once, such as bulk-editing, bulk-resolving or bulk-updating incidents, alerts or services. The API and MCP server are only developer building blocks for scripting bulk actions, and the Signals Migrator is a one-time config migration, a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
